name: Custom Logo
description: Replace the default Jellyfin logo with your own.
overview: Replaces the Jellyfin logo in the web client header and splash screen with an image you upload.

versions.changelog: Rebuilt for Jellyfin 10.11 (.NET 9) and 12.0 (.NET 10). The logo is now actually applied, by injecting a managed block into the server branding CSS. Added a working configuration page with upload, preview and removal. Build for Jellyfin 12.0.x.
